# psr.bd (BTCP — Bangladesh Tax Compliance Platform)

> Bangladesh tax compliance platform for tax lawyers and chambers: PSR (Proof of Submission of Return) preparation, Section 104 audit shield checks, Section 166 books tracking, client and return management, and deadline tracking under the Income Tax Act 2023.

## Key pages

- Home: https://psr.bd/
- Pricing (Free and Pro plans): https://psr.bd/pricing
- Calculators: https://psr.bd/calculators
- Knowledge base: https://psr.bd/knowledge-base
- Login: https://psr.bd/login

## What psr.bd does

- Client management for tax chambers (Free plan: first 5 clients; Pro plan: unlimited)
- Tax return management (Free plan: first 5 draft returns; Pro plan: unlimited)
- Deadline tracking (general annual deadline calendar on Free; per-client deadlines on Pro)
- Free audit risk simulator for the Section 104 audit shield (15% income-growth self-assessment protection)
- PSR (Proof of Submission of Return, Section 264) preparation support
- Section 166 books-of-accounts and voucher gap/risk identification
- Free calculators, blog, knowledge base and checklists
